jess_procurement: Heads-up: NordicCompute flagged an import license delay for our FRA H100 shipment. They offered: airlift 10 units now (+upcharge) + sea the rest, or swap up to 20% for A100s at -15%. Need decision by EOD CET.
liam_sre: eu-west pools at ~9% headroom. If we don't airlift we'll need traffic routing. What's the air premium?
jess_procurement: Quote: +18% per unit, broker fee €110/unit. Sea-only would be +5% and +2–3wk ETA. Vendor can pre-generate AWBs if we confirm.
anya_logistics: FRA depot rule: AWB must include PO else they hold. If we split, we need separate AWBs and manifest updates. We can stage partial arrivals for RMA reconciliation but need prepaid return labels for DOAs to avoid processing delays.
sam_infra: Accepting 20% A100 swap (16 units) increases p95 by ~8–12% on some workloads. We can route less-sensitive jobs to A100s. Ops-bot: "gpu-queue" alerts rising 1.8x.
liam_sre: Proposed plan: 1) Accept swap for 16 A100s to canary pool; 2) Airlift 8 H100s for critical traffic; 3) Sea remainder + reserve 20 FRA depot slots for RMA staging.
jess_procurement: I'll negotiate uplift cap to +12% and ask vendor to waive broker fee if we accept phased sea. Also requesting prepaid RMA labels and immediate serial list for pre-clearance. Decision needed by 18:00 CET.
anya_logistics: I'll prebook depot slots and prepare manifests once vendor confirms AWBs. Reminder: inbound AWB must show PO RW-2025-117 or depot will reject.
sam_infra: Approved from infra. I'll prepare routing flips and throttles.
liam_sre: +1, will update runbooks and monitoring.
ops-bot: deployment-bot: scheduled routing changes at 03:00 UTC if decision confirmed.
